text: Do you experience any pain, numbness, or tingling that radiates from your neck or shoulder down into your arm? I also need to know if you have noticed any weakness or coordination issues in your legs or other limbs.

speaker: Doctor
text: The normal MRI and biopsy results make a structural tumor or direct nerve compression unlikely.
